executiveSummary: The 180 distinct scanned forms contain 92 positive, 78 mixed and 9 negative assessments; one cropped form cannot be classified confidently. Praise centres on staff service, enjoyable stays and the setting. Food variety (19 forms), service speed (14) and the access road (11) are the most frequent specific concerns. Good or excellent tick-box scores often coexist with complaints, so the score average alone does not describe the experience. Three forms report pests and two raise room-lock security issues; these deserve prompt checks. Figures are reconstructed from scans only. Reporting periods use supplied batch labels, with date discrepancies noted; the first entry has no scans and is excluded.

insights.title: Check room locks promptly
insights.detail: Two distinct forms in the 31 Aug–6 Sep batch report room-lock problems. One explicitly describes the issue as a security concern. These are guest reports, not verified maintenance findings.
insights.recommendation: Inspect and test affected locks using the private source records, check other guest-room locks, and record repairs and follow-up.

insights.title: Investigate pest reports
insights.detail: Three forms across two reporting periods mention pests: rodents/mosquitoes in rooms, mosquitoes in rooms, and cockroaches in a conference room. Positive marks elsewhere do not cancel these reports.
insights.recommendation: Inspect the reported spaces, review pest-control and cleaning records, address entry points and verify follow-up results.

insights.title: Broaden food choice and keep options available
insights.detail: Food variety is flagged on 19 forms; availability on 5. Requests include buffet variety, drink choices and later menu availability. These counts overlap and should not be added as unique guests.
insights.recommendation: Review buffet rotation and stock planning; communicate unavailable dishes before orders, and assess a limited late-evening menu.

insights.title: Improve speed and keep guests informed
insights.detail: Service speed is flagged on 14 forms. Two forms specifically request a call when food is ready. One form praises prompt staff in prose while marking speed as needing improvement; both signals are retained.
insights.recommendation: Track order-to-service time, agree who notifies guests when orders are ready, and review breakfast readiness and table clearing.

insights.title: Repair missing or nonworking room essentials
insights.detail: Amenities are flagged on 9 forms and room maintenance on 8, with overlap. Comments mention missing mirrors or appliances, nonworking televisions/heaters and bathroom problems.
insights.recommendation: Use a room-readiness checklist for amenities, television, hot water, shower and leaks. Track reported faults through resolution.

insights.title: Improve the arrival experience
insights.detail: The access road is flagged on 11 forms, and wayfinding on 5. The latter includes signs and directions within or approaching the property.
insights.recommendation: Assess road repairs with the responsible parties and add clear approach signs and arrival directions.

insights.title: Review food temperature, freshness and portions
insights.detail: Five forms flag food temperature, three flag freshness and six flag portions. One guest reports pork was not fresh; this report needs checking rather than being treated as a confirmed food-safety event.
insights.recommendation: Review food holding and service routines, investigate freshness reports and standardize portions against what guests are offered.

insights.title: Preserve the hospitality guests value
insights.detail: Explicit praise includes service on 29 forms, staff friendliness on 7 and professionalism on 3. These categories can overlap; tick-box-only positive ratings are not included in these praise counts.
insights.recommendation: Recognize the behaviours guests praise and use them in coaching, alongside the specific service concerns.

insights.title: Keep the setting and enjoyable stays central
insights.detail: Forty-nine forms explicitly praise the overall experience and 12 praise the ambience. Several of these same forms also request improvements.
insights.recommendation: Preserve the welcoming setting while addressing the concrete concerns listed in mixed feedback.
